shortlist.name: C12-200 (hepatocyte)
shortlist.source: Love et al. PNAS 2010 / numerous reviews
shortlist.notes: Strong hepatocyte uptake; widely used for hepatic gene editing.

notes: Consider TME normalization (losartan/Ang(1-7)) alongside intratumoral LNP.
For cancer vaccines, MHC-I presentation of encoded antigen is the priority — clinical SM-102/ALC-0315 work well.
